flight-time.name: Flight Time Calculator
flight-time.intro: Compute flight time from distance and average groundspeed, with time-zone or unit conversion.

runway-length.name: Runway Length Calculator
runway-length.intro: Compute the required takeoff or landing runway length from aircraft performance data.

weight-balance.name: Weight and Balance Calculator
weight-balance.intro: Compute aircraft center of gravity and check it stays within the CG envelope.

huoyun-uld-jizhuangqi-guige.name: Cargo ULD Specification Reference
huoyun-uld-jizhuangqi-guige.intro: Look up unit load device (ULD) dimensions, tare weights and capacities for air cargo.

length-temp-runway.name: Runway Length (Altitude/Temperature Correction)
length-temp-runway.intro: Compute the corrected runway length from pressure altitude and temperature.

fuel-consumption.name: Fuel Consumption Estimator
fuel-consumption.intro: Estimate fuel consumption from fuel flow rate and flight duration.

assessor-capacity.name: Terminal Capacity Assessment
assessor-capacity.intro: Assess airport terminal capacity and security throughput against passenger demand.

stats-weight-luggage.name: Luggage Weight Statistics
stats-weight-luggage.intro: Compute statistics of luggage loading and weight distribution.

wing-area-from-loading.name: Wing Area from Wing Loading
wing-area-from-loading.intro: Compute the required wing area from weight and wing loading.

wing-loading.name: Wing Loading Calculator
wing-loading.intro: Compute wing loading as weight divided by wing area.

lift-to-drag-ratio.name: Lift-to-Drag Ratio Calculator
lift-to-drag-ratio.intro: Compute aerodynamic efficiency as the lift-to-drag ratio.

bank-angle-load.name: Bank Angle Load Factor Calculator
bank-angle-load.intro: Compute the maneuver load factor from bank angle.

reynolds-number.name: Reynolds Number Calculator
reynolds-number.intro: Compute Reynolds number from density, velocity, characteristic length and viscosity.

escape-velocity.name: Escape Velocity Calculator
escape-velocity.intro: Compute escape velocity from the gravitational constant and body radius.

orbital-velocity.name: Orbital Velocity Calculator
orbital-velocity.intro: Compute orbital velocity from the gravitational parameter and orbital radius.

centripetal-accel.name: Centripetal Acceleration Calculator
centripetal-accel.intro: Compute centripetal acceleration from velocity and turn radius.

thrust-to-weight.name: Thrust-to-Weight Ratio Calculator
thrust-to-weight.intro: Compute the thrust-to-weight ratio from thrust and weight.

dynamic-pressure.name: Dynamic Pressure Calculator
dynamic-pressure.intro: Compute dynamic pressure from air density and velocity.

aspect-ratio.name: Aspect Ratio Calculator
aspect-ratio.intro: Compute wing aspect ratio from wingspan and wing area.

turn-rate.name: Turn Rate Calculator
turn-rate.intro: Compute the angular turn rate of an aircraft in a coordinated turn.

lift-coefficient.name: Lift Coefficient Calculator
lift-coefficient.intro: Compute the lift coefficient from lift, dynamic pressure and wing area.

lift-equation.name: Lift Equation Calculator
lift-equation.intro: Compute lift from dynamic pressure, lift coefficient and wing area.

drag-force.name: Drag Force Calculator
drag-force.intro: Compute drag force from dynamic pressure, drag coefficient and reference area.

rocket-delta-v.name: Rocket Delta-V Calculator
rocket-delta-v.intro: Compute rocket delta-v from effective exhaust velocity and mass ratio.

delta-v-rocket.name: Tsiolkovsky Rocket Equation Calculator
delta-v-rocket.intro: Compute delta-v with the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation from Isp and mass ratio.

lift-force.name: Wing Lift Force Calculator
lift-force.intro: Compute wing lift force from the lift equation and wing parameters.

specific-impulse.name: Specific Impulse Calculator
specific-impulse.intro: Compute specific impulse (Isp) from thrust and propellant mass flow.

climb-rate.name: Rate of Climb Calculator
climb-rate.intro: Compute the rate of climb from excess power and weight.

payload-fraction.name: Payload Fraction Calculator
payload-fraction.intro: Compute the payload fraction from initial and final mass.

orbital-period.name: Orbital Period Calculator
orbital-period.intro: Compute the orbital period from the orbital radius.

descent-rate.name: Descent Rate Calculator
descent-rate.intro: Compute the rate of descent from vertical speed and configuration.

turn-radius.name: Coordinated Turn Radius Calculator
turn-radius.intro: Compute the turn radius of a coordinated turn from velocity and bank angle.

stall-speed.name: Stall Speed Calculator
stall-speed.intro: Compute the stall speed from weight, wing area and maximum lift coefficient.

breguet-range.name: Breguet Range Calculator
breguet-range.intro: Compute aircraft range with the Breguet range equation from L/D, Isp and fuel fraction.

thrust-required.name: Thrust Required Calculator
thrust-required.intro: Compute the thrust required for level flight (equal to drag).

load-factor.name: Load Factor Calculator
load-factor.intro: Compute the load factor from lift and weight.

mach-number.name: Mach Number Calculator
mach-number.intro: Compute Mach number from true airspeed and local speed of sound.
